title: cdk-construct-eventbridge + eventbridge-rule examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples for both packages together since EventBridge rules are commonly paired with a bus.

packages/cdk-construct-eventbridge/examples/:
- minimal/ — custom event bus, no encryption
- with-kms/ — kmsKeyIdentifier from bridge fixture
- with-policy/ — policyDocument

packages/cdk-construct-eventbridge-rule/examples/:
- minimal/ — eventPattern + targetArn
- with-role/ — targetRoleArn (divergent: adds IAM role assumption)
- cross-bus/ — sourceEventBusName + targetEventBusArn (divergent: cross-bus routing)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in each packages test/ dir.

comments.author: lead-engineer
comments.body: PR merged: eventbridge examples on develop
